entity_reviews.llm_reasoning: The paper discusses Al-doped spinel synthesis and lists aluminum starting materials such as Al(OH)(CH3COO)2 (aluminum acetate hydroxide), Al(NO3)3, Al2O3, and AlCl3 (as “Al(NO3)3”, “Al2O3”, “AlCl3”, and an Al-acetate-based compound) (see Page 2, Experimental: starting materials list). entity_reviews.llm_suggested_fix: Al(NO3)3 | Amount: stoichiometric amount (varied by cationic ratio x in LiAlxMn2−xO4, x = 0–0.12); exact mass not given.
